name: EH3D-DESIGN-HISTORY
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: early code. Semantic history of a design: a Rust library and command line that read a history of operations keyed by the stable identity of an object and chained by SHA-256, find a change in the past, a state that points nowhere and a reference to a deleted object, print the log, compare two histories from where they separate and find the first bad operation by halving. It has only run on data made by its own tests; it reads no design, the producer of the operations belongs to the design tool, and the comparison by the content of the design is not written.
